name: Krka, d. d.
summary: Krka, d. d., a generic pharmaceutical company, develops, produces, markets, and sells prescription pharmaceuticals, non-prescription products, and animal health products in Slovenia, South-East Europe, East Europe, Central Europe, West Europe, and internationally. The company offers prescription pharmaceuticals for cardiovascular, central nervous system, gastrointestinal tract, pain, diabetes, and other therapeutic areas. It also provides non-prescription products for cough, cold, cerebral, peripheral circulation, gastrointestinal tract, metabolism, and other therapeutic areas, as well as analgesics, vitamins, minerals, and vasoprotectives.
